params.label: List the stars with their class

climate-graph.title: Climate graph
climate-graph.blurb: A climate graph from twelve months of temperature and rainfall, with rainfall bars and a temperature line on twin axes and a summary, or a table with empty axes for students to plot.

params.label: Temperature (°C) and rainfall (mm), January to December

population-pyramid.title: Population pyramid
population-pyramid.blurb: A population pyramid from male and female counts for each age band, with a table of the figures and a summary of its shape, or empty axes for students to draw the pyramid.

params.label: Males and females per age band, youngest first

grid-reference.title: Grid references and bearings
grid-reference.blurb: A map grid with numbered lines and features, with four- and six-figure grid references and compass bearings between features worked out, or empty boxes for students to fill in.

params.label: Features: name, then easting and northing
Bearings to find, from feature number to feature number
Number of the first grid line

map-scale.title: Map scale and distances
map-scale.blurb: A map scale (1 : 50 000) with a scale bar drawn to it and measured map distances turned into ground distances, with the workings shown, or left empty for students.

music-staff.title: Staff and notes
music-staff.blurb: Music on a staff written from a text spec like C4 q, E4 q, G4 h, with a clef, key signature, time signature and bar lines, and the note names and beats per bar worked out or left blank for students.

params.label: Notes
params.default: C4 q, D4 q, E4 q, F4 q | G4 h, E4 h | F4 q, D4 q, B3 e, C4 e, r q

circle-of-fifths.title: Circle of fifths
circle-of-fifths.blurb: The circle of fifths with major keys, relative minors and key signatures, a chosen key shaded with its neighbours, or with the names and signatures left blank for students.

piano-keyboard.title: Piano keyboard
piano-keyboard.blurb: A piano keyboard with the keys of a scale or chord marked, for naming the keys, or with the scale or chord named and the keys left for students to mark.

guitar-chords.title: Guitar chord boxes
guitar-chords.blurb: Guitar chord boxes from a name and six fret numbers, with the chord to name, or with the name given and the box left empty for students to mark.

rhythm-counting.title: Rhythm counting
rhythm-counting.blurb: A rhythm written as note and rest lengths in a time signature, drawn with bar lines and a beat grid, with the count under each note and the beats in each bar worked out or left blank for students.

params.label: Rhythm
params.default: q q h | q. e q q | e e e e q q | h r q q

break-even.title: Break-even chart
break-even.blurb: A break-even chart from fixed costs, variable cost per unit and price, with the break-even point, profit and loss regions and a table worked out, or empty axes and a blank table for students.

time-value.title: Time value of money
time-value.blurb: A timeline of cash flows with a rate per period, discounted to the present (or compounded to the last period) in a table, with the factors, values and net present value worked out or left blank for students.

loan-amortisation.title: Loan amortisation table
loan-amortisation.blurb: A loan repayment schedule from the amount, interest rate and term, with the payment, interest, principal and balance of each period worked out, or empty cells for students.

org-chart.title: Organisation chart
org-chart.blurb: An organisation chart from an indented list of roles, with the levels, span of control and number of roles worked out, or with the role titles and answers left blank for students.

params.label: Roles, indented under who they report to
params.default:
Managing Director
  Finance Manager
    Accountant
    Payroll Clerk
  Operations Manager
    Production Supervisor
    Warehouse Supervisor
  Sales Manager
    Sales Representative

swot.title: SWOT analysis
swot.blurb: A SWOT grid of strengths, weaknesses, opportunities and threats, with the numbered points sorted into their boxes, or empty boxes for students to sort the points into.

params.label: Weaknesses (inside, harmful)
params.default: Small kitchen limits output\nNo online ordering

params.label: Opportunities (outside, helpful)
params.default: New office block opening nearby\nGrowing demand for catering

params.label: Threats (outside, harmful)
params.default: A national chain opens in town\nRising flour prices

marketing-funnel.title: Marketing funnel
marketing-funnel.blurb: A marketing funnel from the number of people at each stage, with the conversion rate between stages, the overall rate and the cost per customer worked out, or left blank for students.

params.label: Stages: name, then how many reached it
params.default:
Saw the advert 20000
Visited the website 4000
Signed up 800
Made a purchase 120

plot-arc.title: Plot arc
plot-arc.blurb: A plot arc of five stages (exposition, rising action, climax, falling action, resolution) with a story's events placed along it, or blank stage names for students to label.

params.label: What happens at each stage, in order
params.default:
Cinderella lives with her unkind stepfamily
She is forbidden to go to the ball, but her fairy godmother helps
At the ball the prince falls in love with her
She flees at midnight and loses a slipper
The prince finds her and they marry

organiser.title: Graphic organiser
organiser.blurb: A T-chart, KWL chart or Venn diagram with the items sorted into place, or empty columns or circles with the items listed mixed up for students to sort.

params.label: Heading of the first column or circle
First column (T-chart, Venn) or Know (KWL)
params.default: Water boils at 100 degrees\nThe moon orbits the Earth

params.label: Second column or circle, or Want to know (KWL)
params.default: Summer is the best season\nMaths is boring

timeline.title: Timeline
timeline.blurb: A timeline of dated events drawn to scale, with the span and the longest gap worked out, or with the dates or event names hidden for students to fill in.

params.label: Events: date then what happened
params.default:
1492 Columbus reaches the Americas
1620 Mayflower lands at Plymouth
1776 Declaration of Independence
1803 Louisiana Purchase
1861 Civil War begins
1865 Civil War ends

cause-effect.title: Cause and effect web
cause-effect.blurb: A web of causes arrowing into a central event and effects arrowing out of it, with the causes and effects sorted into place, or empty boxes and a mixed-up list for students to sort.

params.label: Causes
params.default: Heavy rain for a week\nSnow melting in the hills\nThe river banks were low

params.label: Effects
params.default: Families leave their homes\nThe market is closed\nA new flood wall is built

family-tree.title: Family tree
family-tree.blurb: A family tree of couples and their children from an indented list, with the generations, number of people and descendants worked out, or with blank name boxes and answers for students.

params.label: People, children indented under their parents
params.default:
George + Martha
  John + Anne
    Sam
    Jo + Pat
  Mary + Tom
    Lucy
  Peter

sentence-diagram.title: Sentence diagram
sentence-diagram.blurb: A sentence diagram with subject, verb, optional object and slanted modifiers, or the sentence and an empty frame of the same shape for students to fill in.

params.label: The sentence
params.default: The tall boy kicked the red ball.

structure-chart.title: Structure chart
structure-chart.blurb: Boxes joined by labelled arrows, for a government, a trade route or any system, with the arrow labels shown or left blank for students to write.

params.label: Links: from -> to : what the arrow means
params.default:
Congress -> President : sends bills to be signed
President -> Congress : can veto bills
President -> Supreme Court : appoints judges
Supreme Court -> Congress : can strike down laws
Congress -> Supreme Court : confirms judges

food-plate.title: Food plate
food-plate.blurb: A plate divided into vegetables, grains, protein and fruits by share, with a dairy circle, and foods sorted into their groups, or an empty table and a mixed-up list of foods for students.

params.label: Foods: name, then its group
params.default:
Broccoli: Vegetables
Brown rice: Grains
Chicken: Protein
Apple: Fruits
Yoghurt: Dairy
Carrot: Vegetables
Lentils: Protein
Oatmeal: Grains

heart-zones.title: Heart-rate zones
heart-zones.blurb: Five heart-rate training zones worked out from age (and optionally resting heart rate), with the maximum and the beats per minute of each zone, or blank ranges for students.

params.label: Resting heart rate (0 to use the simple method)

court-layout.title: Court and field layout
court-layout.blurb: A basketball half-court, soccer pitch (with a formation) or volleyball court with numbered player positions, named in a list, or a blank list for students to name them.

body-map.title: Body map
body-map.blurb: A simplified front view of the body with numbered organs, named in a list, or a blank list for students to name them. Choose all organs, the digestive system, or breathing and circulation.

block-diagram.title: Block diagram
block-diagram.blurb: A systems block diagram (input, controller, actuator, process, output) with labelled signals and an optional feedback loop, or empty boxes and labels for students to fill in.

params.label: What the system does
params.default: A room is kept at a set temperature.

params.label: Signals: one for each arrow, input first and output last

free-body.title: Free-body diagram
free-body.blurb: A free-body diagram of an object with its forces drawn as arrows from a list of size and direction, with the net force and acceleration worked out, or the list alone for students to draw.

params.label: Mass in kg (0 to leave out the acceleration)

gear-train.title: Gear train
gear-train.blurb: A train of two to four meshing gears drawn from their tooth counts, with the gear ratio, the speed and the direction of each gear worked out, or left blank for students.

params.label: Teeth on each gear, driver first

orthographic.title: Orthographic views
orthographic.blurb: A stack of cubes drawn from a grid of heights in isometric view, with its top, front and right views, or the isometric drawing and empty grids for students to draw the views.

params.label: Heights of the stacks: one row per line, back row first

colour-wheel.title: Colour wheel
colour-wheel.blurb: A twelve-colour wheel with primary, secondary and tertiary colours, and an optional colour scheme marked on it, or blank names for students to fill in.

params.label: Starting colour (0 is yellow, going round the wheel)

perspective-grid.title: Perspective grid
perspective-grid.blurb: A one-point or two-point perspective grid with the horizon line and vanishing points, and a box drawn on it, or the empty grid for students to draw on.

params.label: Guide lines from each vanishing point
Box position across (% from the middle)
Box position down (% from the horizon, below +, above -)

maslow.title: Hierarchy of needs
maslow.blurb: A pyramid of needs (Maslow's by default, or your own levels) with an example beside each level, or empty bands for students to name.

params.label: Levels, bottom first: name: example
params.default:
Physiological: food, water, sleep
Safety: a home, a job, health
Love and belonging: friends, family
Esteem: respect, achievement
Self-actualisation: reaching your potential

brain-regions.title: Brain regions
brain-regions.blurb: A simplified side view of the brain with the four lobes, the cerebellum and the brain stem numbered, with what each does, or blank names for students to fill in.

experiment-flow.title: Experimental design
experiment-flow.blurb: A flow chart of a controlled experiment, from the sample through random assignment to a treatment and a control group, then measuring and comparing, with the role of each step as answers.

params.label: Question being tested
params.default: Does more sleep raise test scores?

params.label: What each group gets (the control group last)
